(* REQ: LANG-1951 LANG-1952 LANG-1953 LANG-1954 *) theory Demo imports Main begin (* outer (* nested *) still a comment *) datatype shape = Circle nat | Rect nat nat fun area :: "shape ⇒ nat" where "area (Circle r) = 3 * r * r" | "area (Rect w h) = w * h" lemma area_pos: "area s ≥ 0" by (cases s) auto end
